title: Meaning is a difference that makes a difference to a system

statements.text: In IWMT, SOHMs require and allow meaningful integrated information, where meaning is a difference that makes a difference to the system's ability to survive and pursue its goals, including the goal of modeling the world for prediction and control.

sources.quote: meaning is a difference that makes a difference to the ability of a system to survive and achieve its goals
where meaning is understood as differences that make a difference to the ability of systems to pursue their goals
